test_title: PYST 41 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that is the most appropriate conversion of the following sentence into Direct Speech.

The interviewer asked me why I had left my previous job.

options.text: The interviewer said, "Why did you leave your previous job?"
The interviewer said, "Why you have left your previous job
The interviewer said, "Why you had left your previous job?"
The interviewer asked me, "Why you left your previous job?"

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reported Speech:** The given sentence is in indirect speech, where the interviewer is asking a question in the past perfect tense.
 
• **Direct Speech Conversion:** When converting from indirect to direct speech:
 
 
• The reporting verb "asked" changes to "said," as it introduces a direct question.
 
• The past perfect tense "had left" changes to the simple past tense "did leave."
 
• The question format is used, starting with "Why did" and ending with a question mark.
 
 
 
• **Correct Format:**
 
 
• The direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• The first letter of the quoted sentence is capitalized ("Why").
 
• The sentence ends with a question mark inside the quotation marks.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The interviewer said, "Why did you leave your previous job?""*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "The interviewer said, "Why you have left your previous job?""
 
 
• This option is incorrect as the verb "have left" is in the present perfect tense, which is not appropriate for the context.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The interviewer said, "Why you had left your previous job?""
 
 
• This option is incorrect as it uses "had left," which is in the past perfect tense but is not suitable for direct speech in a question.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The interviewer asked me, "Why you left your previous job?""
 
 
• This option is incorrect because it omits the auxiliary verb "did" needed for forming a question in the past tense.
